allow: Bash(node -e "const pkg = require\('./package.json'\); const deps = {...pkg.dependencies, ...pkg.devDependencies}; const missing = []; for \(const [name, ver] of Object.entries\(deps\)\) { try { require.resolve\(name, {paths: [process.cwd\(\)]}\) } catch\(e\) { missing.push\(name\) } }; if \(missing.length\) console.log\('MISSING:', missing.join\(', '\)\); else console.log\('All deps resolved'\)")

Bash(node -e "const q=require\('./src/data/questions.json'\); console.log\('Total questions:', q.length\); console.log\('Weights:', [...new Set\(q.map\(x=>x.weight\)\)]\); console.log\('Sample:', JSON.stringify\(q[0], null, 2\)\); console.log\('Attention checks:', q.filter\(x=>x.attentionCheck\).length\); console.log\('Duplicates:', q.filter\(x=>x.duplicateOf\).length\);")

Bash(node -e "const q=require\('./src/data/questions.json'\); const c=q.filter\(x=>x.weight==='core'\).length; const e=q.filter\(x=>x.weight==='extended'\).length; const d=q.filter\(x=>x.weight==='deep'\).length; console.log\('core:',c,'extended:',e,'deep:',d,'total:',q.length\); console.log\('Quick:',c\); console.log\('Standard:',c+e\); console.log\('Deep:',q.length\);")
